measurement_notes: Engine FPS/CPU monitors update less frequently than frame callbacks. Four-second phase frame-count averages have approximately 0.2-second telemetry boundary uncertainty.
maxRenderMs is cumulative through each phase. Histogram counts are per-phase differences.

A 60fps monitor reading is not a guarantee that every interval is exactly 16.667ms or that every device can achieve it.
